svg.title: $3,000,000 Billings to $165,000 Owner Net
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-billings-to-owner-net; chart type: waterfall; title: $3,000,000 Billings to $165,000 Owner Net; subtitle: Six bars reconcile the canonical Base-Case 5.5% net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD per year. Opening and closing bars are totals; intervening bars are signed deductions. Carrier cost and expense splits are illustrative allocations; the $3,000,000 billings, $165,000 owner net, and 5.5% margin are canonical. Owner net is the scorecard residual, not a modeled personal tax outcome.; caption: $3,000,000 - $2,550,000 - $180,000 - $45,000 - $60,000 = $165,000. Carrier costs leave $450,000 in brokerage gross profit; $285,000 annual operating expense equals $23,750 monthly. Gross shipper billings are the scorecard basis, not automatically recognized operator revenue under an agent accounting presentation.; stages: label: Gross shipper billings; value: $3,000,000 opening total; includes carrier costs; numeric value: 3000000.0; detail: Record the full annual shipper invoice amount as the scorecard denominator. This figure includes money owed to carriers and is not retained brokerage income.; label: Purchased carrier transportation; value: Subtract $2,550,000; retain $450,000 gross profit; numeric value: -2550000.0; detail: Illustrative carrier purchases consume 85% of billings, leaving a 15% brokerage gross margin before staffing, systems, credit losses, and other operating expenses.; label: Pod labor and contractor expense; value: Subtract $180,000 in annual staffing expense; numeric value: -180000.0; detail: Illustrative combined payroll, payroll burden, and contractor spending for the three-full-time, two-contractor pod; reconcile actual owner compensation and local labor costs without counting distributions twice.; label: Systems and operating services; value: Subtract $45,000 in annual systems expense; numeric value: -45000.0; detail: Illustrative allowance for TMS, load-board access, Highway or RMIS verification, shipment visibility, communications, and invoice-reconciliation services; obtain actual vendor quotes before commitment.; label: Other overhead and loss expense; value: Subtract $60,000 in annual residual expense; numeric value: -60000.0; detail: Illustrative combined allowance for insurance, security arrangement costs, administration, acquisition spending, credit losses, claims expense, and funding charges. Restricted trust principal is not an operating expense.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: $165,000 closing total; 5.5% of billings; numeric value: 165000.0; detail: Reconcile to the canonical Base Case exactly. The Conservative case is $1,000,000 at 3% for $30,000; the Scaled case is $5,000,000 at 8% for $400,000.

circle.title: label: Gross shipper billings; value: $3,000,000 opening total; includes carrier costs; numeric value: 3000000.0; detail: Record the full annual shipper invoice amount as the scorecard denominator. This figure includes money owed to carriers and is not retained brokerage income.

label: Purchased carrier transportation; value: Subtract $2,550,000; retain $450,000 gross profit; numeric value: -2550000.0; detail: Illustrative carrier purchases consume 85% of billings, leaving a 15% brokerage gross margin before staffing, systems, credit losses, and other operating expenses.

label: Pod labor and contractor expense; value: Subtract $180,000 in annual staffing expense; numeric value: -180000.0; detail: Illustrative combined payroll, payroll burden, and contractor spending for the three-full-time, two-contractor pod; reconcile actual owner compensation and local labor costs without counting distributions twice.

label: Systems and operating services; value: Subtract $45,000 in annual systems expense; numeric value: -45000.0; detail: Illustrative allowance for TMS, load-board access, Highway or RMIS verification, shipment visibility, communications, and invoice-reconciliation services; obtain actual vendor quotes before commitment.

label: Other overhead and loss expense; value: Subtract $60,000 in annual residual expense; numeric value: -60000.0; detail: Illustrative combined allowance for insurance, security arrangement costs, administration, acquisition spending, credit losses, claims expense, and funding charges. Restricted trust principal is not an operating expense.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: $165,000 closing total; 5.5% of billings; numeric value: 165000.0; detail: Reconcile to the canonical Base Case exactly. The Conservative case is $1,000,000 at 3% for $30,000; the Scaled case is $5,000,000 at 8% for $400,000.

text.title: Assumptions: USD per year. Opening and closing bars are totals; intervening bars are signed deductions. Carrier cost and expense splits are illustrative allocations; the $3,000,000 billings, $165,000 owner net, and 5.5% margin are canonical. Owner net is the scorecard residual, not a modeled personal tax outcome.
